# Hydrofarm 0.1.0

Initial release for Minecraft 26.1.x — Fabric + NeoForge.

## Added

### Fluids & logistics
- **Liquid Tank** — stackable storage with a rendered fluid level; adjacent tanks merge into one shared pool (water, lava, milk, Liquid XP)
- **Liquid Pipe** and **Item Pipe** — auto-connecting networks; right-click a port for terminal mode with per-face extract/insert and whitelist/blacklist filters
- **Liquid Siphon** — slow AoE extraction from vanilla water sources
- **Sprinkler** — ~2.5× crop growth and auto-hydration across a 9×9, fed by pipes or tanks
- Cauldrons connect to pipes as fluid sources/sinks in whole-level increments

### Growing
- **Hydroponics Bed** — four configurable planter quadrants per bed; auto-harvest and Liquid XP trickle from the cluster's shared water pool
- **Tree Farm Bed** — the same system for saplings: logs and saplings without chopping
- Adjacent beds cluster: shared water, items, and XP with one cluster-wide GUI
- Farmer's Delight and Croptopia crop support

### Animals
- **Animal Capture Net** — pick up an animal as an item
- **Husbandry Bed** — wool, eggs, milk, and honeycomb on feed-and-water cycles
- **Butcher Bed** — a breeding pair sustains slaughter loot and Liquid XP without consuming the stock

### Energy & utility
- **Hydroelectric Generator** — water in, energy out (Team Reborn Energy on Fabric, FE on NeoForge)
- **Energy Pipe** and multiblock **Energy Cell** power bank
- **Autocrafter** — energy-powered template crafting from piped-in ingredients
- **Mending Station** — repairs gear with Liquid XP + energy, pipe-automatable
- **Monster Repulser** — energy-upkeep field that blocks hostile spawns
- **XP Drain** — bank levels as Liquid XP (20 mB/XP) and withdraw them later

### Decoration & integrations
- 17 dye-colored **Glowcubes** with a slow internal swirl
- **Jade** overlays, **ModMenu**/Mods-screen config GUI, `capturenet` mod deference
- `config/hydrofarm.properties` + in-game config screen (render toggles, sprinkler particles, per-bed XP output)
